# Third-party files

- `vosk.js`: [vosk-browser](https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser) 0.0.8 (Apache-2.0). Offline speech recognition compiled to WebAssembly; runs in a Web Worker.
- `../model/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.tar.gz`: [Vosk small US English model](https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models) 0.15 (Apache-2.0), repacked as a `.tar.gz` for vosk-browser.
